stages.reference: Study only the restrained secondary optical character of old black stained glass. The matching base layer already establishes a deep smoke-charcoal translucent body; this separate detail material adds slight cooled ripples, a few isolated air seeds, gently worn surface haze and very faint irregularities in thickness. Let each mark disappear naturally into the black glass instead of becoming a white scratch or visible line drawing. Keep the pigment family unchanged, the contrast exceptionally quiet and the transmission of light possible wherever the source permits it. Avoid drawing an entire new pane, borders, lead joints, stone veins, glossy reflections, fractured glass or solid opaque backgrounds. The purpose is to enrich the parent glass, not compete with it.
